headline: The Halide camera app now offers full control of the iPhone 18 Pro’s aperture
summary: Halide camera app updates for iPhone and iPad. It adds full support for iPhone 18 Pro's variable aperture. The update also introduces two new photography looks.

headline: All the latest news on Meta’s cute, creepy Muse AI agent
summary: Meta launched Muse, a new AI agent for various tasks. It aims to help with emails and online purchases. Its effectiveness depends on trusting Meta with your data.

headline: Google reportedly tests paying publishers for AI search results
summary: Google is piloting a program to pay publishers. Payments are for content used in its AI-powered search features. This move addresses scrutiny over AI's impact on web traffic.

headline: Instagram is adding an AI ‘assistant’ to tell you how to post
summary: Instagram's Edits app now includes an AI 'creative assistant'. It offers feedback and suggestions on user posts. The AI pulls data from user accounts for tailored advice.

headline: Ted: The Animated Series Announced With Original Movie Cast Returning
summary: Peacock officially announced 'Ted: The Animated Series'. Seth MacFarlane, Mark Wahlberg, and Amanda Seyfried will return. The original movie cast will voice their roles.

headline: The Best, Worst, and Weirdest Star Wars Prequel Trilogy Games
summary: An article explores games from the Star Wars prequel era. It reviews the best, worst, and weirdest titles. Many games were released during this period.

headline: 'This Is Your Dreamcast Moment' — Former PlayStation Boss Offers New Xbox CEO Some Words of Advice
summary: Former PlayStation boss Shawn Layden advised the new Xbox CEO. He urged her to 'pick a lane' for Microsoft's gaming business. The situation was compared to Sega's Dreamcast era.

headline: Pokémon Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Mega Dimension Physical Bundle Announced
summary: Nintendo announced a physical Switch 2 version of Pokémon Legends: Z-A. The bundle includes the Mega Dimension DLC. A new edition for the upcoming console is confirmed.

headline: 'We've just taken control': Passengers describe what happened on flight
summary: Passengers describe moments after a stabbing on a Flydubai flight. The incident occurred on a flight bound for Israel. Videos filmed by passengers capture the aftermath.

headline: UK believes Iran involved in RAF Fairford incident, PM says
summary: The UK Prime Minister suggests Iran's involvement in the RAF Fairford incident. Comments follow the release of suspects on strict bail conditions. An investigation into the security breach is ongoing.

headline: China funding UK research and sending it to Beijing's spies, MI5 warns
summary: MI5 warns UK universities about Chinese research funding. China General Technology Research Institute is linked to Beijing's intelligence. Universities are urged to sever ties with the entity.

headline: Execution of US murderer Christa Pike halted shortly before it was due to happen
summary: Christa Pike's execution was halted at the last moment. She was convicted of murder in 1996. Pike was sentenced to death for Colleen Slemmer's killing.
